_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. We have received golf cart stickers and 10-pack cards and now have everything available for the 2026-2027 golf season. Please stop by the office and complete the membership paperwork found in the hanging files to the right of the window. We will process your form and provide your tag, stickers, and/or cards as quickly as possible. Fees for this golf season remain the same: 1 Membership: $588.50 Golf Cart Fee: $64.20 10-Pack: $153.00 (These are limited to 2 per address per season). 18-Holes: $22 9-Holes: $17 Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
